name: Ximena Bautista-Nwosu
role: Personal security and threat neutralization — bodyguard
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Ximena Bautista-Nwosu are compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 25, they have the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons — and they make no effort to hide it.

They inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. They work as a bodyguard out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Ximena Bautista-Nwosu have built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — they show up, they deliver, they collect.

core_fears: Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
That their reputation is built on luck, not skill, and the luck is finite
core_desires: Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
blind_spots: Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Ximena Bautista-Nwosu sends anonymous tips to GLMZ law enforcement about competitors. It's not principle — it's market manipulation.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Multilingual fragments — switches languages mid-thought, not for privacy but because some concepts only fit in specific tongues.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Repeats the last thing someone said back to them before responding — processing or intimidation
Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
example_lines: "You're paying me to be the thing between you and everything else. Stay behind me."
"I don't protect people I don't respect. Lucky for you, I respect your money."
"The threat you see isn't the one that kills you. Watch my eyes, not my hands."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Ximena Bautista-Nwosu a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Someone is impersonating Ximena Bautista-Nwosu on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
Ximena Bautista-Nwosu intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Ximena Bautista-Nwosu is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When they make a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of their stories.
augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons. Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
inability to delegate — must control everything personally
risk-averse to the point of missed opportunities

decision_rules: Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Talks to their gear — names weapons, thanks tools, treats equipment as companions
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity — every gram is functional mass. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick and powerful. Built like someone engineered to absorb and deliver impact.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with subtle iridescent chrome flecks visible under direct light
physical_description.hair_style: Short, practical fade — easy to maintain between jobs, no loose ends to grab
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint luminescent flicker around the iris — subcutaneous optical enhancement, barely visible in daylight
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown — melanin-rich complexion reflecting West African and Mexican heritage, evenly distributed across their frame
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with high cheekbones and a squared jaw. Skin appears almost metallic in certain light — result of active dermal camouflage layer beneath the epidermis. Small scar through left eyebrow from a blade. Minimal grooming beyond function — no jewelry, no cosmetics, no softening gestures.
distinguishing_marks: Thin vertical scar through left eyebrow, approximately 3cm long, pale and old
Faint chromatic patterning visible across shoulders and collarbone when dermal camouflage activates — hexagonal pixel-like arrays that ripple under skin
Barely-visible ritual scarification on right hip — three parallel lines, cultural marker from Nwosu family line, only visible if clothing shifts
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Smartgun link in right forearm — visible as a seamless chrome integration at the wrist, with faint data-port detents along the radial bone. The chrome does not quite match natural skin tone; the transition is surgical-clean. Dermal camouflage substrate visible as a subtle iridescent sheen across upper body in direct light — skin sometimes shifts in tone microscopically, like oil on water.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with controlled economy — no wasted motion. Stands slightly off-center, weight favoring left leg, right side angled for quick access to forearm link. Head tracking is precise and methodical; they scan rooms like threat assessment is automatic. Default expression is neutral, almost serene, but eyes are always working. Handshake is firm but not aggressive. In motion, they move like something wound tight.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatism: reinforced cargo pants (charcoal gray, multiple pockets, ballistic weave subtle), form-fitting undershirt (synthetic blend, heat-dissipating), modular overjacket (dark matte finish, removable sleeves, internal holster points). Boots are mil-spec, broken in, with steel toe caps. No corporate logos. No affectation. All clothing has concealment pockets and retention points. Between jobs, they wear nearly identical outfits in neutral tones — easier to maintain cover identity if you never change the pattern.
